summary: The candidate fixes the core/file and several backend key paths, including the reviewed Aibrix logical-FP8 collision, but remains a partial fix: exact-candidate probes reproduce dtype collisions in NPU MemCache and SiMM, while FlexKV and LMCache remain unverified.

tests.what_was_measured: On the recorded base, HiCacheStorageConfig lacks kv_cache_dtype and two otherwise identical bf16/fp8 file-backend runs derive the same page_model_0_1 key.
The exact candidate's regression suite passed 62 tests, covering its Aibrix fix and modified in-tree paths.
On the exact candidate, production NPU MemCache and SiMM key transformations still produce identical component keys for fp8_e4m3 and fp8_e5m2.

gpu_execution.evidence: One AMD Instinct MI355X gfx950 was visible, but the defect and counterexamples are deterministic string/key derivation and did not require GPU kernels.

remaining_counterexamples: NPU MemCache accepts a dtype-bearing HiCacheStorageConfig but _tag_keys and component-key derivation omit it; fp8_e4m3 and fp8_e5m2 collide.
SiMM accepts a dtype-bearing HiCacheStorageConfig but batch_exists/key preprocessing omit it; fp8_e4m3 and fp8_e5m2 collide.
FlexKV external client key derivation was unchanged and could not be verified because its package/service is absent.
LMCache external client key derivation was unchanged and could not be verified because its package/service is absent.
remaining_limitations: Aibrix, FlexKV, LMCache, memcache_hybrid, and SiMM packages/services were unavailable.
No Ascend NPU, model weights, serving workload, or multi-node setup was available.
Aibrix, NPU MemCache, and SiMM validation used their in-tree client boundaries with stubs, not end-to-end services.
No native source changed, so a native rebuild was not applicable.
